subject.title: feat(skill-workshop): add restore action for quarantined proposals and display scan findings

question: Should an operator-admin restore move a proposal to pending even when the refreshed scan still reports critical or warning findings?
rationale: Both designs preserve apply-time rescanning, but they expose different quarantine semantics to Gateway clients and determine whether quarantine is a sticky security state or a reversible review state.

options.title: Approve reversible quarantine
options.body: Keep restore-to-pending, document that it enables revision rather than approval, and require proof that non-clean content remains blocked and is re-quarantined if applied through another client.

options.title: Keep quarantine sticky
options.body: Allow revision while quarantined and transition to pending only after a clean rescan, preserving quarantine as an explicit security state.

options.title: Ship findings only
options.body: Pause the restore RPC and expose scan findings first until the lifecycle contract has explicit owner approval.

recommendation.title: Approve reversible quarantine
recommendation.body: Keep restore-to-pending, document that it enables revision rather than approval, and require proof that non-clean content remains blocked and is re-quarantined if applied through another client.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Skill Workshop security-boundary work makes joshavant the strongest available owner for the quarantine-state decision.
